subject: maths
question: A hollow spherical metal ball having an internal radius of 6.3 cm was cut into two equal parts. One part was filled with water whereas the other was kept empty. What is the volume (in cm³, rounded off to one decimal place) of water in the bowl (take n = (22)/(7) ) ?
solution:
**Data:**

Radius of the sphere = 6.3 cm.

**Concept:**

Volume of a hemisphere = 2/3πr³.

**Solution:**

Volume of water = 2/3 × (22/7) × 6.3³ = 523.9 cm³.

**Therefore, the volume of the water in the bowl is 523.9 cm³.**
